mostWorthwhile.text: Combining varied survivors with advancing ice made natural selection across generations clear, especially alongside the separate migration route.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the oasis was straightforward but initially offered little explanation of its role; the following combination made it more meaningful.

surprise.text: The river migration passage changed my view of survival: moving depended on connected routes and a suitable destination, not just escaping the cold.

arbitrary.text: Combining surviving lineages with the Sun to end the ice age felt compressed: the result shows warmth returning but does not explain the climate change driving it.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the surviving lineages reshape the world, particularly after the chapter contrasted adaptation, migration and loss.
